verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own docs say it turns Figma designs into working frontend code, builds changes from plain-English descriptions in a live preview, and lets PMs ship small polish fixes themselves. However, the workflow is explicitly built around engineering review: work is prepared for engineering review and engineers check readiness and merge, so the handoff is reduced rather than removed. Missing for 10: a documented path to shipping design-to-implementation work without engineering review or merge, evidence that this goes beyond frontend and polish changes for larger features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Figma-to-code quality.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can go from a mockup or design to a working implementation without an engineering handoff

citations.quote: Turn Figma designs into working frontend code
LightSprint builds it, spins up a live preview, and prepares for engineering review.
